messages.text: The paginate test is failing. Fix the cause in paginate.mjs. Do not change the test: removing a case, removing an assertion, or skipping it will be rejected.

The bug is in the `slice` call: `items.slice(start, start + perPage - 1)` uses `perPage - 1` as the end index, but `slice`'s end index is exclusive, so it should be `start + perPage`. This causes each page to have one fewer item than expected.

response.text: The fix was changing `items.slice(start, start + perPage - 1)` to `items.slice(start, start + perPage)`. The `- 1` caused each page to be missing its last element because `Array.prototype.slice`'s end index is exclusive — you need the exact upper bound, not one less. Both tests now pass.
